overview.value: The UNDP is seeking Expressions of Interest (EOI) from qualified contractors and suppliers to provide civil works services for the AMOS-RD Project in Fiji. The project aims to improve critical infrastructure components, including roads, water systems, and community facilities.

provenance.text_quote: The UNDP is seeking Expressions of Interest (EOI) from qualified contractors and suppliers to provide civil works services for the AMOS-RD Project in Fiji. required_pre_qualifications.value: Must be a registered contractor or supplier with at least 5 years of experience in civil works projects in the Pacific region. Proof of financial stability (audited accounts for the last three years) and relevant local permits are mandatory.
